events.title: What is Law in the Age of AI?
events.description:
AI is changing more than how we work. It is changing how power works.
Our legal systems were built for a world where people, companies, and governments were the primary actors. Increasingly, software makes decisions. It shapes what we see, determines which options are available to us, and acts on our behalf, or on behalf of someone else.
This is a harder problem than regulating a new technology. It is a new kind of power, and our institutions were not designed for this.
Join us for a fireside chat with leaders at the forefront of AI and law on what happens when analog-era institutions meet a radically different kind of power — and what the law may need to become in response.
